The ClearView 27-inch 1440p Monitor is available at both stores. While Trailmart lists the item for $295.00 with free shipping, their warehouse policy requires purchasing this specific monitor in pairs, which exceeds your budget. Peakgear offers the monitor for $299.00 plus $5.99 shipping (total $304.99), which is within your $341 budget and allows for a single-unit purchase.

I have processed the order for one monitor from Peakgear.
